'''Mistress of Ships''' is a title given to the ruler of the [[Atha'an Miere]]. She is a woman of great power among the [[Sea Folk]], much like a queen. It is common for a Mistress of Ships to be married to the [[Master of the Blades]], though it's not necessary or even expected. Under her in command are numerous [[Wavemistress|Wave mistress]]es, and under them are the [[Sailmistress]]es.

==Known Mistresses of the Ships==
*[[Nesta din Reas Two Moons]] - killed by the [[Seanchan]]
*[[Zaida din Parede Blackwing]] - raised after Nesta's death

==Future Mistress of the Ships==
Min saw in one of her infallible visions that one day [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]] will eventually be elected Mistress of the Ships.
